Name: Ridgeside Village - Alissa Makeover
Author: Dasone1986
Description:
This is a cosmetic mod for the character Alissa from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url].

Alissa's character sprites felt a little flat and shrunk so I remade the character sprite to look more like the original locals in Stardew Valley without removing hers characteristic look.

This mod only alters her character model and not her portrait.

There's an option to remove her nose in the config.json file. Just set the nose value to "false" to remove it.

Downloads.Description:
Changed character model for Alissa for more native look.
Fixed the look and animation when she perform.
